questions.topic: PrepLadder · 23.Ludwig's Angina, Pharyngeal Pouch and Abscess related to Pharynx
questions.stemHtml: A 7-year-old child presents to the ER with rapidly progressing swelling under the jaw and difficulty breathing. On examination, there is bilateral submandibular swelling with elevation of the tongue, but no trismus or fluctuation. He reports recent dental pain in his lower molars. Which anatomical connection is primarily responsible for the rapid bilateral spread of this infection?

options.label: A
options.text: Between the submental and parapharyngeal spaces

options.label: B
options.text: Between the sublingual and retropharyngeal spaces

options.label: C
options.text: Between the submandibular and submental spaces

options.label: D
options.text: Between the submental and buccal spaces
